verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as bulk deleting, archiving or tagging chats, are a fair axis for a self-hosted AI chat platform. However, the evidence pack documents no native multi-select or batch action. API keys that let scripts call endpoints are a developer building block, and scheduled automations are a different feature, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
